DLC2303:3:t_1:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...What looks like mere lashing out to others can often hold deep meaning for the person doing it.」

DLC2303:3:t_1:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Though I cannot deny that it is an ugly sight...」

DLC2303:3:t_1:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The story I am about to tell takes place near the end of the $$時獄戦役$$... just before the decisive battle with $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

DLC2303:3:t_1:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「When $$リディ$$ returned to $c from home, the cheerful young man he had once been was gone. He was always shrouded in gloom.」

DLC2303:3:t_1:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「His negative words and behavior toward $$バナージ$$ in particular left everyone on edge.」

DLC2303:3:t_1:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Sensing this atmosphere, $$ブライト$$ decided to dump this headache... I mean, entrust its resolution... to someone else.」

DLC2303:3:t_2:3.en: ～$$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$: Captain's Cabin～

DLC2303:3:t_2:4.en:
$$ブライト$$
「...I'm sure you've noticed the situation too...」

DLC2303:3:t_2:6.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Then this won't take long.」

DLC2303:3:t_2:7.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Understood. ...It's a problem between pilots. Leave this one to me.」

DLC2303:3:t_2:10.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Nothing... I thought you'd put up a fight like you used to, but you accepted so readily...」

DLC2303:3:t_2:11.en:
$$ブライト$$
「You've grown as a person too.」

DLC2303:3:t_2:13.en:
$$ブライト$$
「I'm not teasing. I thought it wouldn't be long before you became the father of the mobile suit squad.」

DLC2303:3:t_2:16.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I still have my hands full dealing with my own problems. That's why I want to clear up any disputes quickly. That's all.」

DLC2303:3:t_2:17.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Soon I won't be in a position to play squad leader anymore...」

DLC2303:3:t_2:21.en: ～$$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$: Hangar～

DLC2303:3:t_2:24.en:
$$リディ$$
「The decisive battle with $$ネオ・ジオン$$ is almost here. We don't have time for that...」

DLC2303:3:t_2:25.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ will wait in this sector for the other ships to join us until the last possible moment. Our training will double as reconnaissance.」

DLC2303:3:t_2:26.en:
$$アムロ$$
「If you don't want to die, follow my instructions. Briefing in ten minutes.」

DLC2303:3:t_2:28.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Something like this happened before, didn't it?」

DLC2303:3:t_2:29.en:
$$カツ$$
「That time, we ended up fighting $$ジオン$$ remnants...」

DLC2303:3:t_2:30.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But without that experience, I don't think I would have survived.」

DLC2303:3:t_2:33.en:
$$リディ$$
「I'm going ahead. Don't be late, any of you.」

DLC2303:3:t_2:35.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
（$$カツ$$... Do you think $$アムロ$$ is...?）

DLC2303:3:t_2:36.en:
$$カツ$$
（Yeah... He must have something in mind about $$バナージ$$ and Ensign $$リディ$$...）

DLC2303:3:t_3:3.en: ～$$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$: Captain's Cabin～

DLC2303:3:t_3:4.en:
$$ブライト$$
「...I see. Things have settled down for now, then.」

DLC2303:3:t_3:6.en:
$$ブライト$$
「But now we can concentrate on the $$アクシズ$$ operation. You can focus on dealing with $$シャア$$ too.」

DLC2303:3:t_3:8.en:
$$ブライト$$
「I've known you and $$シャア$$ a long time.」

DLC2303:3:t_3:9.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But he's the leader of $$ネオ・ジオン$$ now. He's more than a mere pilot like me can handle.」

DLC2303:3:t_3:10.en:
$$ブライト$$
「I'm having the $$ラー・カイラム$$ hurry. We may not join up until we're near the point of no return, but I'll make sure we get there in time.」

DLC2303:3:t_3:12.en:
$$ブライト$$
「I want to settle things with him too. Don't get ahead of yourself, $$アムロ$$.」

DLC2303:3:t_3:14.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The battle at $$アクシズ$$... You have your own hopes for it as well, Captain.」

DLC2303:3:t_3:15.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...I think of it as a waypoint.」

DLC2303:3:t_3:17.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Yes... For me, for $$シャア$$, and for humanity as well.」

DLC2303:3:t_3:18.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I feel that what lies beyond it is where our real battle will be.」

DLC2303:3:t_3:21.en:
$$アムロ$$
（I'm sure the door to a new age lies beyond it...）

DLC2303:3:t_3:22.en:
$$アムロ$$
（Even if I can't open it myself, I can make the road that leads there.）

DLC2303:3:t_3:23.en:
$$アムロ$$
（$$カミーユ$$, $$バナージ$$, $$リディ$$, $$カツ$$, $$ハサウェイ$$... Your generation will discover what lies beyond.）

DLC2303:3:t_3:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...These unseen hardships are what have made $$アムロ$$ look old... I mean, mature beyond his years.」

DLC2303:3:t_3:29.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$ブライト$$ might look good growing a beard to compete, but that would be a rather ominous flag...」

DLC2303:3:t_3:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「At any rate, keep a close eye on $$バナージ$$ and $$リディ$$'s relationship from here on.」

DLC2303:4:t_000:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...As I explained in the briefing, $$バナージ$$ and $$リディ$$ will fight each other first.」

DLC2303:4:t_000:1.en:
$$カツ$$
（So this mock battle really is meant to do something about those two...）

DLC2303:4:t_000:2.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
（But I don't think this approach will work...）

DLC2303:4:t_000:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Both of you, pay attention. Watching is part of your training too.」

DLC2303:4:t_000:9.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You don't seem convinced. Then get out of the $$ユニコーン$$.」

DLC2303:4:t_000:11.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The battles ahead will be different from anything you've faced so far. If you fight with halfhearted resolve, you'll lose that machine.」

DLC2303:4:t_000:12.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Don't forget, $$バナージ$$. That machine is the key to $$ラプラスの箱$$, which $$ネオ・ジオン$$ is after.」

DLC2303:4:t_000:14.en:
$$リディ$$
「If you're not willing to fight, go back to the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$. And seal away the $$ユニコーン$$.」

DLC2303:4:t_000:15.en:
$$リディ$$
「It would be better for you.」

review.context: Before Axis, Bright asks Amuro to address Riddhe's hostility toward Banagher. Amuro arranges combat training; later he explains that winning at Axis is only a step toward humanity's future.
decisions: Amuro's military rank is Captain; Riddhe's is Ensign.
The interception limit is rendered as the point of no return for Axis interception.
AG's beard joke retains the metatextual ominous-flag wording.
Amuro's future squad-leader remark means personal focus on Char, established by his later talk with Bright.
Caption repair preserves the source blank header, blank lines, indentation and fullwidth wave decorations; the translated location remains in the body.
